## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Kilocode worker console redirect REFERENCE-ONLY (cli, tui, worker, console capture)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #15166 (merged 2026-10-18) fixes worker console writes corrupting TUI frame. Commit title: "fix(cli): keep worker console writes off the TUI frame". Issue: Libraries running in the TUI session worker write to stdout the same one OpenTUI renderer owns. OpenTUI repaints only changed cells, so a `console.warn` from worker realm (e.g. MCP SDK's OAuth issuer notice) landed on live frame and survived until full redraw, shredding the screen. OpenTUI's console capture patches `globalThis.console` in renderer realm only, which Worker does not share. Fix: route worker console writers into rotating log file instead of stdout. Related commit: PR #15180 hardens agent usage outcome precedence (test error before completion time) and adds index-coverage regression test.

- **Why**: Alexi audit 2026-10-18: grep for `new Worker`, `Worker(`, `worker.postMessage` returned zero matches in `src/`. Alexi TUI implementation (`src/cli/tui/`, `src/cli/interactive.ts`) uses Ink components directly without worker isolation. No worker realm = no worker console pollution. REFERENCE-ONLY: if Alexi adds worker-based session execution (to isolate MCP server SDK console noise or prevent blocking tool calls from freezing TUI render), reference this pattern for worker console redirect (patch `globalThis.console` in worker, route to rotating log file instead of stdout).

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15166 (worker console redirect), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src (grep verified no Worker usage)

- **Category**: N/A (cli, tui, worker, console capture, reference-only)

- **Size**: SKIP. Alexi does not use Workers in TUI, worker console pollution not applicable.

#### 2. Kilocode MCP OAuth refresh ALREADY IMPLEMENTED (mcp, oauth, token refresh)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #15131 (merged 2026-10-18) adds automatic MCP OAuth token refresh. Commit title: "fix(cli): refresh expired MCP OAuth tokens automatically". Feature: detect expired OAuth tokens (401/403 with token-expired hint or expiry timestamp past), call refresh flow (exchange refresh_token for new access_token via OAuth provider), retry original MCP call with fresh token. Bounded single-flight: multiple concurrent calls to same expired server share one refresh attempt, preventing thundering-herd refresh loops.

- **Why**: Alexi audit 2026-10-18: `src/mcp/refresh.ts` exists (directory listing confirmed). File header: "MCP OAuth token refresh with bounded single-flight." Grep confirmed `src/providers/auth.ts` L324 "Refresh an expired OAuth access token using the stored refresh token." Feature ALREADY IMPLEMENTED. SKIP - no gap.

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15131 (MCP OAuth refresh upstream), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/mcp/refresh.ts (implementation verified), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/auth.ts L324 (refresh helper)

- **Category**: N/A (mcp, oauth, token refresh, already implemented)

- **Size**: SKIP. Alexi already implements MCP OAuth token refresh. Verified 2026-10-18.
